text:
sophie yang: urgent help pls. I had to pay an emergency consulate expedite fee to get a replacement passport for client travel — paid on personal card $320 USD. Can finance reimburse fast? Travel tomorrow morning.
matt (travel-ops): whoa hope you're ok. Did you try embassy corporate support? Normally we purchase visa/passport services via vendor account but for emergency replacements personal payment is allowed if approved. Upload the consulate receipt and any police or consulate incident number.
sophie yang: uploading receipt_photo.jpg and consulate_ref.png now. Receipt line: "EXPEDITE FEE 320 USD". incident ref: CN-4521. I also have the travel authorization email for client meeting — attaching meeting_invite.pdf.
expense-bot: Policy flag: EMERGENCY_DOCUMENT. Finance requires manager approval AND proof of expedited service for reimbursements faster than payroll.
karim (manager): Confirming Sophie was diverted due to lost passport at airport and needed same-day replacement to meet the client. Approve reimbursement and request priority payout. :white_check_mark:
hana (finance): Thanks. Two options: (A) Priority reimbursement (bank transfer) if manager approval + consulate receipt + travel proof; typical ETA 2 business days. (B) Payroll advance if you need funds before 2 days (next payroll run ~5-7 days). Which do you prefer? Also need last 4 of personal card for internal reference.
sophie yang: priority reimbursement please. last4 = 3344. I really need it before flight costs pile up.
hana (finance): Received. Marking expense PRIORITY and creating ticket FIN-9801-P. Please confirm consulate charged in USD and that receipt is itemized.
sophie yang: receipt shows USD 320 and itemized as "EXPEDITE SERVICE 320". No extra tax.
hana (finance): Good. Final ask: paste a 1-line explanation of why vendor invoice couldn't be billed to corporate vendor account (for audit).
sophie yang: "Lost passport discovered at airport; consulate required same-day payment and vendor account setup would have delayed processing beyond travel window"
hana (finance): Perfect. Payout queued. finance-bot: Reimbursement status PRIORITY. Reference FIN-9801-P. Expected settlement 2 business days. If funds needed sooner, reply again and we'll consider payroll advance.
sophie yang: Thank you all so much  this helps a ton. Flying now.
